title: Next.js probe — matrix SUMMARY (not attachable to a single-cell claim)
summary: Minimal Next.js 16.3.1 app reading data/artifact.json in a Server Component. Matrix: read API {fs.readFileSync, await readFile} x cacheComponents {disabled, enabled}. Protocol per cell: render A; write B from a separate process touching no application code; wait 10s; read module-scope server counters via a route handler so browser behaviour cannot be mistaken for server caching; then make a fresh request. RESULT — ALL FOUR CELLS IDENTICAL: nothing happened during the quiet window (0 page requests, 0 file reads); the fresh request returned B; counters confirmed the server re-read the file and re-rendered. Step 6: an app-supplied SSE route watching the data directory delivered a change event to a connected client within the window in both cacheComponents modes, and a reload then showed B.
notes: Kept as the summary of the whole run and deliberately UNATTACHED. Its environment says cacheComponents:'both' and readApi:'both', which environment-MISMATCHES every claim about one configuration — the applicability filter excluded it from all four, correctly, and that is how the modelling error was caught. A matrix run is N experiments and must be recorded as N. The per-cell records carry the bearing; this one carries the protocol.
